solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Female fighting unit by a road — it's probably out in the country

definitions.text: it's probably out in the country

parts.note: an army is a unit of fighting soldiers

explanation.surface: A woman's regiment marches along a road somewhere out in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just puts the pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A yard surrounded by farm buildings is typically found in rural areas, away from towns.

clue.text: Leading character, pretty keen

parts.note: A is the first letter of the alphabet
cute means pretty

explanation.surface: The star of the show is rather enthusiastic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pretty' looks like an adverb modifying keen, but it means attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen and sharp senses are both described as very sensitive or perceptive.

clue.text: Champ makes boxer suffer? It's a sensational story!

definitions.meaning: a person chomps on a dog of the boxer breed
a journalism phrase for an unusual, newsworthy event

explanation.surface: A champion's fighter suffers, and it makes headline news.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Champ' means chew and 'boxer' is a dog breed, so the first part pictures a human biting a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Newspaper wisdom says a dog biting a person is not news but the reverse is.

clue.text: Local dignitary stupidly alarmed any number

indicators.note: stupidly suggests the letters of alarmed are put in a foolish order

parts.note: N stands for an unspecified number in maths

explanation.surface: A town worthy is foolishly alarmed by some number.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior member of a borough or city council is a civic official.

clue.text: Fellow's skill with diagrams — thus his grand map may take shape

indicators.note: take shape means the letters of thus his grand map form something new

explanation.surface: A man's drawing talent lets his great map come to life.
explanation.definitionFit: Ability in technical drawing and drafting plans is the craft of a drafter.

clue.text: Bishop managed church — part of a big organisation

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
to run something is to manage it, so managed gives ran

explanation.surface: A bishop ran a church that belongs to some larger body.
explanation.definitionFit: A local office or division of a large company or institution is one of its arms.

clue.text: Black insect — something in the wardrobe?

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
a louse is an insect

explanation.surface: A dark bug found lurking among the clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A top worn by women, a garment one would hang in a closet.

clue.text: Ruler once more not elected

indicators.note: not means leaving out the letters for elected

parts.note: again means once more
in means elected, as a party voted in

explanation.surface: A former ruler fails to win election a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: An Ottoman title for a military commander or chief officer.

clue.text: Greek character needing shelter gets leg stuck in tree

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: stuck in places the word for leg within the word for shelter

parts.note: lee is shelter from the wind
pins are informal legs

explanation.surface: A Greek seeking cover gets his leg trapped in a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Another name for the monkey puzzle, a South American conifer.

clue.text: Game one lout wrecked

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a game
the Roman numeral for one is I
a ned is a Scottish slang word for a young hooligan

explanation.surface: A yob wrecked a match.
explanation.walkthrough: NED is Scottish slang for a lout or hooligan.
explanation.definitionFit: Something destroyed or spoilt beyond repair has been brought to ruin.

clue.text: Fragrant actor, I am fancied

indicators.note: fancied in the sense of imagined or made fanciful, telling us to rearrange the letters

explanation.surface: A sweet-smelling performer declares himself attractive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancied' is the anagram signal applied to ACTOR I AM.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something giving off a pleasant, spicy smell.

clue.text: Fairy embraced by superiors

indicators.note: embraced by says the answer is held within the letters of the next word

explanation.surface: A fairy is hugged by those above her.
explanation.definitionFit: In Persian mythology a peri is a beautiful supernatural being, a sprite.

clue.text: Man is joining attempts to provide places for documents

parts.note: Reg is a man's name
tries are attempts

explanation.surface: A man joins in with attempts to supply places to keep papers.
explanation.definitionFit: Offices where official records are kept and filed are where documents are stored.

clue.text: Return from time off before coaching, one having got up

parts.note: rest is time off work

indicators.note: in a down entry, got up means the letter for one rises higher in the word

parts.note: tuition is coaching
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Coming back from a break before training, one has risen.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'got up' means a letter moves higher, i.e. earlier in the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Restoring something lost or stolen to its owner is giving it back.

clue.text: Reveal translated part of scripture as appropriate

indicators.note: translated means the letters of reveal are rendered into a new form

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, part of the Bible

explanation.surface: Revealing a translated passage of the Bible as fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pertinent or applicable to a matter is suitable for it.

clue.text: Very good to be involved in fantastic miracle, it's found from experience

indicators.note: involved in places the pious piece within the shuffled letters
fantastic suggests miracle is twisted into an unrecognisable form

parts.note: PI, short for pious, is crossword shorthand for very good

explanation.surface: Something good mixed up in a wondrous event, learnt through experience.
explanation.walkthrough: PI, short for pious, is crossword shorthand for very good.
explanation.definitionFit: Knowledge based on observation and testing rather than theory is derived by experiment.

clue.text: Item of underwear seen as a mistake

definitions.meaning: a petticoat-like undergarment worn under a dress
a small error, as in a ... of the tongue

explanation.surface: A piece of lingerie showing is considered an error.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a woman's undergarment and a minor error or lapse.

clue.text: Vehicle hadn't moved — vehicle kept inside

indicators.note: kept inside places the second vehicle within the shuffled letters
moved says the letters of hadn't are shifted

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A vehicle that wouldn't move with another kept in a garage.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'hadn't' is ignored, as punctuation always is.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cart pushed or pulled by hand is a simple means of transport.

clue.text: A quiet journalist took off

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
ED, short for editor, is a crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A quiet journalist departed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'took off' looks like left, but here it means mimicked.
explanation.definitionFit: To take someone off is to mimic or imitate them, as a copycat does.

clue.text: Tribespeople giving warning about dangerous bird once?

parts.note: the moa was a giant flightless bird of New Zealand, now extinct
'bites!' is the warning given about a creature that is dangerous

explanation.surface: Tribespeople cautioning others about a fearsome extinct bird.
explanation.walkthrough: The warning sign would read 'Moa bites', a caution about the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moabites were an ancient people of the Bible, living east of the Dead Sea.

clue.text: Greek region, a dry one with cold autumn initially

parts.note: TT is teetotal, meaning dry or abstaining
the Roman numeral for one is I
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of autumn

explanation.surface: A Greek area that is dry, with one chilly autumn at first.
explanation.definitionFit: The area around Athens is a historic territory of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Being put into correct position in bed, cheered up

indicators.note: in places one piece within the other, here inside the word for bed

parts.note: taken as written
to righten something is to set it right, to put it in its proper place

explanation.surface: Being straightened up in bed lifted someone's spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: To lift one's mood or make more cheerful is to lighten or gladden.

clue.text: Press, say, returning to biblical city

parts.note: Ur of the Chaldees was the biblical city of Abraham

indicators.note: returning means the abbreviation for say is read backwards

parts.note: e.g. means for example, as say does

explanation.surface: Reporters, for instance, going back to an ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Press' looks like journalists; it is the verb, to push or insist.
explanation.definitionFit: To press someone is to push or strongly encourage them to act.

clue.text: Actor that may be seen high up on building

definitions.text: that may be seen high up on building
definitions.meaning: the triangular upper part of a wall beneath a pitched roof

explanation.surface: A performer spotted at the top of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname of the Gone with the Wind film star and the peaked end of a roof.

clue.text: Mischievous trick? That's disgusting!

parts.note: a scam is a trick or swindle
pish is an exclamation of disgust or contempt

explanation.surface: Someone reacts in disgust to a naughty prank.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaving like a rascal or imp, playfully naughty.

clue.text: Silent male and maiden outside university

indicators.note: outside means the two letters sit around the university letter

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A quiet man and woman stand outside a college.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a maiden is an over with no runs scored, abbreviated M on scorecards.
explanation.definitionFit: Keeping mum means saying nothing, staying quiet.

clue.text: Having elbows out. I am OK moving with a bit of bending

indicators.note: moving says the letters of I am OK are shifted around
a bit of picks out just the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone says they are fine while doing a little bending with elbows sticking out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges I AM OK together with B, 'a bit of bending', the word 'with' joining them.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing with hands on hips and elbows turned outward is the posture meant.

clue.text: Old girl and a learner meeting university man after upset

parts.note: L is the learner plate abbreviation

indicators.note: the word man after being upset is rearranged

explanation.surface: A former schoolgirl and a learner meet a university man after a quarrel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like a quarrel in the surface but signals the shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: A female former student of a school or college is a graduate of it.

clue.text: Inventor of a shelter to be immersed in water?

indicators.note: immersed in places the shelter pieces inside the word for water

parts.note: pee is urine, making water
a tent is a shelter

explanation.surface: Someone who devises a tent that can go underwater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'water' here is the bodily kind: to make water is to urinate.
explanation.definitionFit: A person holding a patent is typically the inventor of the protected device.
